review.description: S5 now requires component versions derived from exact package bytes and explicit fixed issues backed by ancestor fix commits; exact artifact promotion remains intact. Adopt current target's PR-only feature verification and main-only push policy while preserving exact comparisons, fixture suites and release artifact provenance.
review.implementation: CI package_components reads tar/ZIP manifests and fixed_issues checks source ancestry and fixing references before writing or accepting the CI manifest. Local fixture port overrides coordinate Playwright, assembled testhost and exact daemon origin while retaining defaults, loopback, strictPort, fresh servers and health checks; ordinary hosted checks still use the default configuration. The release publisher now checks out full source history at the already verified exact commit so historical fixed-issue ancestry remains independently verifiable. Rebase preserves incoming main-only push workflow unchanged. Feature publication requires current PR verification; only a successful main push can authorize delivery. No receipt sidecars, check weakening or CI exception is added.
review.tests: Read the new component-tampering and fixed-issue tests: invented versions, missing issue references and non-ancestor commits fail while valid backed references pass. Normal Playwright configuration on alternate UI/host ports runs the three assembled-daemon fixtures, including authenticated fetch and forbidden direct iframe requests. Invalid shell-text/out-of-range ports fail before fixture launch. Existing schema/tooling suites and the complete fixture gate remain mandatory. Report widget named elements, scoped meanings, explicit connection endpoints and progress assertion ownership now receive substantive layer review; generated sections and receipts are regenerated by the CLI, never hand-edited. Reviewed the new privacy rejection graph branch, publication recovery and stale-failure assertions, strengthened real-provider-substitute deadline oracle and owned pagination-progress assertion; rendering and reconciliation remain CLI-generated. Reviewed identity-preserving delayed-success and dispatch-evidence assertions and their S3/S4 anchors; fixture cleanup now has explicit bounded child execution. Layer ownership, stable identities and CLI-only receipt generation remain unchanged. Replaced empty-registry delivery evidence with actual guarded delivery verification from a workflow-depth local clone and historical fix record; no assertion or ancestor/reference policy is waived. Reviewed the new evidence retry assertion ownership and serialized header-array privacy stimuli; generated sections and records remain CLI-owned and the historical adoption policy is unchanged. Reporting concurrency fixture verification now owns a bounded child process and cleans it before private resource removal, preserving the original concurrent state/effect assertions; no agent or model credential runs in fixture suites. Fresh comparison is current main. All previous comparison receipts were retained as authentic historical evidence and are regenerated only by this CLI run after the combined tree is rendered/built; local current-target makeci follows.
